description: This file defines the CalendarProviderInstanceFactory class, responsible for creating instances of calendar providers based on their type, including loading provider classes from files and handling errors.

classes.name: CalendarProviderInstanceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating calendar provider instances, handling class loading and validation.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a calendar provider instance if the type is enabled; logs errors and returns null otherwise.

methods.name: instantiateProvider
methods.description: Loads the provider class file, verifies class existence and inheritance, and returns an instance of the provider.
